HELPING THE TAGBANUA TRIBE COMMUNITY OF CORON ISLAND
Since the start of this pandemic we have been donating regularly rice to the Tagbanua Tribe Community of Coron Island and we have been also paying the medicines of all Tagbanua Tribe Coron Island members that asked for it (they are around 2500 people......).
Just between October 2021 and February 2023 we have donated over 1,000 sacks of rice (50.000 kg). We have also helped in the payment of the hospital bills, school expenses, burials expenses, schools repairs and a lot more.
SAVING STREET CATS AND STREET DOGS
We have been rescuing street dogs and street cats, curing them and feeding them. We have a small rescue center close to Coron town where we do not have cages but where they are free to run and play in around 5.000 square meters of land
RICE DONATIONS TO THE TAGABANUA TRIBE VILLAGES OF CORON ISLAND - CABUGAO AND BANUANG DAAN

IF CHILDRENS ARE PART OF THE GROUP:
Unfortunately this booking system does not accept the selection for kids, please add them to the Adults number if your kids are older than 2 years. Do not add them if they are less than two years old and please advise about them in the "note" of the reservation before to complete your booking since they will be free in all the family rooms!
